Initiative

Capital Behind Bars Initiative

2025

The Capital Behind Bars Initiative is featured publicly by MASLOC as part of its enterprise development work.

It was launched in collaboration with the Ghana Prison Service and Aboboyaa Company Limited.

MASLOC publishes the initiative on its official website as part of its mandate to widen access to microcredit, small loans and enterprise support for Ghanaians.

Editorial note

A launch date, beneficiary numbers and programme outcomes are not published on the official site and have therefore been omitted. Supply verified details before this article is published (see MISSING-CONTENT.md).
